newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures close slightly higher.

text.p: UK wheat futures closed higher on Tuesday as farmers appeared to have finished selling for now.
"We had a good run with farmers willing to sell, but now it seems they have stopped and people are talking in terms of them not coming back until the New Year," said a trader.
Gains in wheat futures were small on Tuesday, but if farmers stay away pre-Christmas supplies could become tight forcing futures higher as buyers seek cover.
Wheat closed 0.15 to 0.45 stg up after trading 343 lots.
Barley futures drifted lower in thin trading mainly due to a lack of demand.
Barley closed 0.25 to 0.75 stg down after trading 39 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract was neglected.
